name: arthome-core
description: The Arthome domain, contracts and shared tooling.

scripts._comment:emit-diff: IN `verify` since the commit that turned it green, and not before: a gate wired in red is a gate switched off within a day (D-065). It reads dist/, so it builds first. It emits TWICE — once to learn the export names, once as a registry, because without one z.toJSONSchema inlines every nested object and a $ref never survives.
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:offline && pnpm run check:prettier-conflict && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:emit-diff && pnpm run check:map
scripts.verify:offline: pnpm run check:versions && pnpm run check:tsconfig && pnpm run check:enums && pnpm run check:language && pnpm run check:core-entry && pnpm run check:openapi && pnpm run check:vocabulary && node -e "console.log('\n  NOTE verify:offline is the subset that needs no install. It does NOT run format:check, lint, typecheck or test. Run pnpm run verify before pushing.')"
